Specifications.Memory Slots: Memory soldered to systemboard, no slots, single-channel (8GB models)
Specifications.Storage Support: One drive, up to 1TB M.2 2242 SSD
Specifications.Speakers: User-facing stereo speakers, 1.5W x2, optimized with Dolby Audio
Specifications.Touchpad: Buttonless Mylar surface multi-touch touchpad, supports Precision TouchPad (PTP), 69 x 104 mm (2.72 x 4.09 inches)
Specifications.Standard Ports:
2x USB 3.2 Gen 1
1x USB-C® 3.2 Gen 1 (support data transfer, Power Delivery and DisplayPort™ 1.2)
1x HDMI® 1.4
1x Headphone / microphone combo jack (3.5mm)
1x Card reader
1x Power connector
Specifications.Docking:
Various docking solutions supported via USB-C. For more compatible docking solutions, please visit
